ai_summary: Asset Reconstruction Company (India) Limited (ARCIL) has announced the appointment of Mr. Kartik Manimuthu as its new Chief Technology Officer (CTO), effective October 1, 2026. This significant senior management addition brings over a decade of extensive experience in FinTech, AI, Machine Learning, and cloud transformation, including leading substantial technology initiatives and data strategy at SMC Group. The appointment suggests a strategic focus on enhancing ARCIL's technological capabilities and digital transformation, with no apparent red flags.
